title: MDM, Customer 360, Business 360 & Reference 360
intro: Mastering splits cleanly: the MDM RUNTIME plane (ingest, read, xref) is real and headless, while the MDM DESIGN plane (business entity, match/merge, deploy) has no REST route at all. Verified live 2026-07-26 with a bogus twin on every probe. Note that P360 (Product 360) is a DIFFERENT product with no REST API - do not conflate it with MDM SaaS.

blocks.intro: Every endpoint in this service, with the exact HTTP verbs it accepts. Where an endpoint accepts more than one verb they are all listed.
rows: 201 — bare field map; trustScore is a STRING  —  untested: GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE
Read a master record by runtime id
405 / 404 — no public search  —  rejected: GET 404, POST 405; untested: PUT, PATCH, DELETE
DEPLOY a business entity to the runtime

UI ONLY - THE hard wall for mastering. 6 route shapes all 404 CMN00005 (/deploy, /deployment, /model/deploy, /publish, /mdm-config/api/v1/deploy, /data360/mdm/api/v1/deploy) and NO 405 anywhere => the route does not exist, which is different from a verb limit. Business 360 Modeler Publish is a click. CORRECTED 2026-07-26: an earlier pass claimed the clone-through-migration backdoor was CLOSED on this pod, off a 404 MigrationSvc_025. That was WRONG - the probe sent Content-Type application/json. With multipart/form-data the same route accepts an upload (see the migration section). The backdoor is OPEN; what this org lacks is a BUSINESS_ENTITY template to clone from.

FAKE-200 GATEWAY ARTIFACT on the idmc-api host: 200 with a 2646-byte body AND the bogus twin returns a BYTE-IDENTICAL 200 (Law 2), so it is prefix routing, not a handler. Never cite as capability. On the bare domain it is 503; on the pod host 404. untested: POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE.
404 — B360 Console click  —  rejected: GET 404, POST 404; untested: PUT, PATCH, DELETE
97 MDM_* design objects; Deployed business-entity census

200, count 0 - but the type filter is NOT validated so count 0 is WEAK evidence. The strong read is unfiltered GET /public/core/v3/objects?limit=5: on Org B it returned count=1 (a single Project named Default), proving the org holds essentially no design objects.
Business entity / source system / ref entity authoring
v3 migration clone — design layer only

VERB EXISTS on Org B: empty POST -> 400 RDM.0040044 "No input given to required..." = validator reached (Law 5), NOT a rejection. GET -> 405, bogus twin -> 404 => real handler. Do not read the 400 as "rejected". Sibling /rdm-service/api/v1/referenceDataSets 404s, which alone is NOT evidence that Reference 360 is unavailable.
404  —  rejected: GET 404; untested: POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE
GET disputed 200 vs 404. PUT and PATCH documented

GET -> 403 means the ACL layer was reached, i.e. the plane is real. It is NOT proof the entity exists: the same 403 fires identically for ZZFAKEENTITY, so the ACL check runs BEFORE metadata lookup. To test existence use POST .../entity/{be}?sourceSystem=X - a 404 'metadata with GUID cannot be found during load' means no such business entity. untested: POST, DELETE.
Source records. USE THIS for source-system updates
Search across or within business entities
Match against the published match model
Create / alter a business entity definition

12 candidate host+path shapes swept live 2026-07-26, ALL 404 or DNS-dead, every one matching its bogus twin: .../model/businessEntity, /mdm-model/, /model/public/, /cs/public/, /business-entity/{private,internal}/api/v1/businessEntities, /data360/mdm-model/, /data360/businessentity/, /saas/public/mdm/v1/, plus hosts <pod>-mdm-model, <pod>-b360 and <pod>-cs (all NXDOMAIN). No 405 anywhere => no route, not a verb limit. Whatever B360 Modeler calls is not on a public plane.
Determine whether a business entity is deployed

THE reliable probe. POST .../entity/{be}?sourceSystem=X returns 404 'The requested metadata with GUID {be} cannot be found during load' when the entity is not deployed, and that fired IDENTICALLY for Person, person, c360.person AND ZZFAKEENTITY - i.e. the org has nothing modeled. Do NOT use GET entity/{be}/{id} for this (its 403 precedes metadata lookup). Corroborate with unfiltered GET /public/core/v3/objects?limit=5, which returned count=1 (one Project named Default). When a model IS deployed this POST flips 404 -> 201, making it a clean automated gate check.

blocks.title: MCP coverage for this service
blocks.intro: The Customer Identification MCP server covers MDM. Its fuzzy-match action is the second thing MCP can do that REST cannot, because REST exposes no public search resource here.
rows: Fuzzy identity match returning the business ID of the best-matching master record.
MCP ONLY. REST has no public MDM search or list resource.
The consolidated golden record, merged across source systems.
REST equivalent is the disputed GET on entity/{be}/{id}. MCP is the safer path.

notes.label: Mastering is entitled long before it is reachable.
notes.text: This org holds 83 MDM privileges - full CRUD on mdm.asset.be, .srcsystem, .hierarchy, .relationship, .jobdef and .appmodel, plus execute.mdm.flows, manage.mdm.jobs and manage.mdm.schedules - and the login user holds MDM Designer and Customer 360 Data Steward/Manager/Analyst. None of that yields a deploy verb. Entitlement and reachability are separate questions: read privileges for the first, probe routes for the second.

notes.label: P360 is not MDM SaaS. Do not answer a P360 question from this section.
notes.text: Informatica MDM - Product 360 (P360) Cloud Edition is a separate AWS-hosted PIM with NO REST API. Deployment is triggered by uploading an empty do_deploy.txt marker file into an S3 customization folder; workflows deploy through the ActiveVOS console UI; DEV->QA->PROD promotion is a support ticket with a 4-hour window. Source: MDM Product 360 Cloud Edition Configuration and Customization Guide v10.0. A 'headless P360' answer means scripting S3 file drops, not calling an API.

notes.label: The runtime plane is real even when every path 404s.
notes.text: On a pod where data360/* returns fake-200s, the <pod>-mdm host still discriminates: GET entity/{be}/{id} -> 403 against a bogus twin's 404, and GET /rdm-service/external/v1/search -> 405 against 404. A 404 on that host is therefore 'wrong path', not 'no service'.

notes.label: MDM job / flow / x360 planes: privileges without routes.
notes.text: execute.mdm.flows, manage.mdm.jobs and view.mdm.x360 are all granted, yet 11 job/flow host+path shapes and 5 x360/config shapes all 404 on this pod. Holding a privilege does not imply the route is mounted - and mounting is per-pod, so this is UNTESTED elsewhere, not absent.

open_questions: MDM read-by-id: GET /business-entity/public/api/v1/entity/c360.person/{id} returned 200 in early-July testing but a later review concluded every MDM runtime path 404s under correct auth and the earlier 200s were identity-service login HTML. Re-probe and check the CONTENT TYPE, not just the status code.

Is there any public search or list resource for golden records? Both reviews agree there is not, but the vendor deck documents a 'search' resource - confirm against the Business 360 REST API Reference.

The B360 Modeler UI must call something to author a business entity. 12 public shapes are now excluded; the remaining hypothesis is a non-public/internal plane or a session-cookie-only endpoint. Capturing the browser network trace during one Publish would settle the biggest UNTESTED gap in this section.

Whether a BUSINESS_ENTITY exported from another org imports cleanly into a pod holding zero MDM design objects. The import route is open (multipart) and export is proven elsewhere, but the cross-org retarget was never attempted end to end.
